  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-032 specifies that in Emergency mode, the SFMC software must prioritize critical functions (life-support, navigation, propulsion) over nonessential functions. This is a clear, specific, and testable functional requirement related to software behavior under a defined operational mode (Emergency mode). The SRS defines Emergency mode in section 1.3 and includes related emergency operation requirements in section 4, supporting traceability and context. The requirement aligns with NASA-HDBK-2203-5.09 guidance on functional requirements (§3.2.1) and minimum recommended content (§1.b), ensuring clarity and scope. No SWE linkage is justified as the NPR passages do not explicitly address prioritization of functions in emergency mode, and the Handbook guidance is general. The requirement is well-written, unambiguous, and supported by SRS context, thus quality is acceptable with no issues."
